“Cut out for yourself two tablets of stone similar to the first ones,
et scribam super eas verba, quæ habuerunt tabulæ quas fregisti.
and I will write upon them the words which were held on the tablets that you broke.
ut ascendas statim in montem Sinai,
so that you may immediately ascend onto Mount Sinai,
and you shall stand with me on the summit of the mountain.
Let no one ascend with you,
nec videatur quispiam per totum montem:
and do not let anyone be seen throughout the entire mountain.
et oves non pascantur e contra.
do not let the oxen or the sheep pasture up against it.”
And so he cut out two tablets of stone,
et de nocte consurgens ascendit in montem Sinai,
And rising up in the night, he ascended onto Mount Sinai,
just as the Lord had instructed him,
And when the Lord had descended in a cloud,
calling upon the name of the Lord.
And as he was crossing before him,
patient and full of compassion and also truthful,
who preserves mercy a thousand fold,
nullusque apud te per se innocens est;
and with you no one, in and of himself, is innocent.
You render the iniquity of the fathers to the sons,
ac nepotibus in tertiam et quartam progeniem.
and also to their descendants to the third and fourth generation.”
Moses bowed down prostrate to the ground;
ait: Si inveni gratiam in conspectu tuo,
he said: “If I have found grace in your sight,
obsecro ut gradiaris nobiscum (populus enim duræ cervicis est) et auferas iniquitates nostras atque peccata,
I beg you to walk with us, (for the people are stiff-necked) and take away our iniquities and our sin,
“I will enter into a pact in the sight of all.
signa faciam quæ numquam visa sunt super terram,
I will perform signs which have never been seen on earth,
opus Domini terribile quod facturus sum.
may discern the terrible work of the Lord that I will do.
Observa cuncta quæ hodie mando tibi:
Observe everything that I command you this day.
ego ipse ejiciam ante faciem tuam Amorrhæum,
I myself will drive out before your face the Amorite,
Cave ne umquam cum habitatoribus terræ illius jungas amicitias,
Beware that you do not ever join in friendship with the inhabitants of that land,
and cut down their sacred groves.
Do not be willing to worship any strange god.
The jealous Lord is his name.
Ne ineas pactum cum hominibus illarum regionum:
Do not enter into a pact with the men of those regions,
cum fornicati fuerint cum diis suis,
when they will have fornicated with their gods
vocet te quispiam ut comedas de immolatis.
someone might call upon you to eat from what was immolated.
Nec uxorem de filiabus eorum accipies filiis tuis:
Neither shall you take a wife for your son from their daughters,
fornicari faciant et filios tuos in deos suos.
they may cause your sons also to fornicate with their gods.
You shall not make for yourselves any molten gods.
You shall keep the solemnity of unleavened bread.
For seven days, you shall eat unleavened bread,
in the time of the month of what is new.
mense enim verni temporis egressus es de Ægypto.
For in the month of springtime you departed from Egypt.
Omne quod aperit vulvam generis masculini,
as much of oxen as of sheep,
The firstborn of a donkey, you shall redeem with a sheep.
sin autem nec pretium pro eo dederis, occidetur.
But if you will not give a price for it, it shall be slain.
The firstborn of your sons you shall redeem.
nec apparebis in conspectu meo vacuus.
You shall not appear empty in my sight.
For six days you shall work.
die septimo cessabis arare et metere.
On the seventh day you shall cease to cultivate and to harvest.
Solemnitatem hebdomadarum facies tibi in primitiis frugum messis tuæ triticeæ,
You shall observe the Solemnity of Weeks with the first-fruits of the grain from the harvest of your wheat,
and a Solemnity when the time of the year returns
quando redeunte anni tempore cuncta conduntur.
Tribus temporibus anni apparebit omne masculinum tuum in conspectu omnipotentis Domini Dei Israël.
Three times a year, all your males shall appear in the sight of the Almighty, the Lord God of Israel.
Cum enim tulero gentes a facie tua, et dilatavero terminos tuos,
For when I will have taken away the nations before your face,
ascendente te, et apparente in conspectu Domini Dei tui ter in anno.
no one shall lie in wait against your land when you will go up to appear in the sight of the Lord your God, three times a year.
Non immolabis super fermento sanguinem hostiæ meæ:
You shall not immolate the blood of my victim over leaven; and there shall not remain,
neque residebit mane de victima solemnitatis Phase.
in the morning, any of the victim of the Solemnity of the Passover.
Primitias frugum terræ tuæ offeres in domo Domini Dei tui.
The first of the fruits of your land you shall offer in the house of the Lord your God.
Non coques hædum in lacte matris suæ.
You shall not boil a young goat in the milk of its mother.”
And the Lord said to Moses,
quibus et tecum et cum Israël pepigi fœdus.
through which I have formed a covenant, both with you and with Israel.”
Fuit ergo ibi cum Domino quadraginta dies et quadraginta noctes:
he was in that place with the Lord for forty days and forty nights;
he did not eat bread and he did not drink water,
et scripsit in tabulis verba fœderis decem.
and he wrote on the tablets the ten words of the covenant.

And when Moses descended from Mount Sinai,
he held the two tablets of the testimony,
et ignorabat quod cornuta esset facies sua ex consortio sermonis Domini.
and he did not know that his face was radiant from the sharing of words with the Lord.

et filii Israël cornutam Moysi faciem,
seeing that the face of Moses was radiant,

both Aaron and the leaders of the assembly.

venerunt ad eum etiam omnes filii Israël:

quibus præcepit cuncta quæ audierat a Domino in monte Sinai.

he placed a veil over his face.
